#Continuous Response

#Scaling

```{r}
#Center y, X will be standardized in the modelling function
#head(prostate)
y <- prostate |>  dplyr::select(lpsa) |>  scale(center = TRUE, scale = FALSE) |>  as.matrix()
x <- prostate |>  dplyr::select(-c(lpsa)) |>  as.matrix()
```

#Train-Test Split

```{r}
set.seed(123)
train <- sample(seq_len(nrow(x)),0.7*nrow(x))

```

#Create function for prediction quality evaluation

```{r}
evaluate_models <- function(models, y_test, x_test){
  
  bias <- function(y, yhat){
    mean(yhat - y)
  }
  
  norm_bias <- function(y, yhat){
    mean(yhat - y) / mean(y)
  }
  
  mse  <- function(y, yhat){ 
    mean((yhat - y)^2)
  }
  
  rmse <- function(y, yhat){
    sqrt(mse(y, yhat))
  }
  
  mspe <- function(y, yhat){
    mean((yhat - y)^2)
  }
  
  #mspe <- function(y, yhat){
   # mean(((yhat - y)/y)^2)
  #}
  
  #rmse <- function(y, yhat){
   # sqrt(mse(y, yhat))
  #}
  
  rmspe <- function(y, yhat){
    sqrt(mspe(y, yhat))
  }
  
  nrmse <- function(y, yhat){
    rmse(y, yhat) / (max(y) - min(y))
  }
  
  mae <- function(y, yhat){
    mean(abs(yhat - y))
  }
  
  mape <- function(y, yhat){
    mean(abs((yhat - y)/y)) * 100
  }
  
  smape <- function(y, yhat){
    mean(2 * abs(yhat - y) / (abs(y) + abs(yhat))) * 100
  }
  
  
  #y <- test_data[[response_var]]
  y <- y_test
  
  results <- lapply(names(models), function(name){
    
    model_obj <- models[[name]]$model
    
    yhat <- as.vector(predict(model_obj, newx = x_test))
    
    data.frame(
      Model = name,
      alpha = models[[name]]$alpha,
      lambda = models[[name]]$lambda,
      Bias = bias(y, yhat),
      Normalized_Bias = norm_bias(y, yhat),
      #MSE = mse(y, yhat),
      MSPE = mspe(y, yhat),
      NRMSE = nrmse(y, yhat),
      RMSE = rmse(y, yhat),
      RMSPE = rmspe(y, yhat),
      MAE = mae(y, yhat),
      MAPE = mape(y, yhat),
      SMAPE = smape(y, yhat)
    )
  })
  
  final <- do.call(rbind, results)
final[ , -1] <- round(final[ , -1], 4) #round to 4 decimal places
final
}
```

#Ridge

```{r}
set.seed(123)    

# Perform 10-fold cross-validation to select lambda
lambdas_to_try <- 10^seq(-3, 5, length.out = 100)

# Setting alpha = 0 implements ridge regression
cv.ridge <- cv.glmnet(x[train,], y[train], alpha = 0, lambda = lambdas_to_try,
                      standardize = TRUE, nfolds = 10)

# Plot cross-validation results
plot(cv.ridge,main="Ridge")

bestlam <- cv.ridge$lambda.min

#Fit Final Ridge Model
ridge.final <- glmnet(x[train,], y[train], alpha=0, lambda=bestlam, standardize = TRUE)

#ridge.predict <- predict(ridge.final,x[-train,])

```

#Lasso

```{r}
# Setting alpha = 1 implements lasso regression
cv.lasso <- cv.glmnet(x[train,], y[train], alpha = 1, lambda = lambdas_to_try,
                      standardize = TRUE, nfolds = 10)

# Plot cross-validation results
plot(cv.lasso, main="Lasso")

bestlam_lasso <- cv.lasso$lambda.min

#Fit Final Ridge Model
lasso.final <- glmnet(x[train,], y[train], alpha=1, lambda=bestlam_lasso, standardize = TRUE)
lasso.final$call$alpha
```

#Elastic Net

```{r}
# Set training control
train_control <- trainControl(method = "repeatedcv",
                              number = 5,
                              repeats = 5,
                              search = "random",
                              verboseIter = TRUE)

# Train the model
elastic_net_model <- train(lpsa ~ .,
                           data = data.frame(lpsa=y[train], x[train,]),
                           method = "glmnet",
                           preProcess = c("center", "scale"),
                           tuneLength = 25,
                           trControl = train_control)

a <- as.numeric(elastic_net_model$bestTune$alpha)
l <- elastic_net_model$bestTune$lambda

#Fit Final Elastic net Model
elnet.final <- glmnet(x[train,], y[train], alpha=a, lambda=l, standardize = TRUE)

```

```{r}
models <- list(
  Ridge = list(model = ridge.final, alpha = 0, lambda = ridge.final$lambda[1]),
  Lasso = list(model = lasso.final, alpha = 1, lambda = lasso.final$lambda[1]),
  ElasticNet = list(model = elnet.final, alpha = a, lambda = l)
)

evaluate_models(models, y[-train], x[-train,])
```

```{r}


m <- evaluate_models(models, y[-train], x[-train,])

metric_cols <- c("Bias", "MSPE", "NRMSE", "RMSE", "RMSPE", "MAE", "MAPE", "SMAPE")



gt_tbl <- gt(m)

# Loop over columns
for (col in metric_cols) {
  min_row <- which.min(m[[col]])  # row index of minimum
  gt_tbl <- gt_tbl %>%
    tab_style(
      style = list(
        cell_fill(color = "yellow"),
        cell_text(weight = "bold")
        #cell_borders(color = "#000000", weight = px(2))
      ),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = all_of(col),  # the column to highlight
        rows = min_row          # the row to highlight
      )
    )
}

gt_tbl

```

#Retrain using all the data

```{r}
ridge.final.all <- glmnet(x, y, alpha=0, lambda=bestlam, standardize = TRUE)
lasso.final.all <- glmnet(x, y, alpha=1, lambda=bestlam_lasso, standardize = TRUE)
elnet.final.all <- glmnet(x, y, alpha=a, lambda=l, standardize = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Models list
models <- list(
  Ridge = ridge.final.all,
  Lasso = lasso.final.all,
  ElasticNet = elnet.final.all
)

# Variable names (assuming X has column names)
terms <- c("(Intercept)", colnames(x))

# Extract coefficients at fitted lambda
coef_table <- sapply(models, function(mod){
  # Convert coefficients to numeric vector
  round(as.vector(coef(mod)),3)
})

coef_table <- data.frame(coef_table)
# Name the rows
rownames(coef_table) <- terms

coef_table2 <- coef_table  |> 
  rownames_to_column(var = "Variable")

# Create gt table with row labels
gt(coef_table2, rowname_col = "Variable")

```

#Logistic regression

#Stepwise Selection

```{r}
LR_model <- glm(psa_binary ~., data = prostate_binary, family = binomial(link="logit"))

#Stepwise variable selection
step_model <- stats::step(LR_model, direction ="both")

stargazer::stargazer(LR_model, step_model, type = "text",
          column.labels = c("Full Model", "Stepwise Model"))


stargazer::stargazer(
  LR_model, step_model,
  type = "latex",
  out = "logit_results.html",
  title = "Logistic Regression Analysis",
  column.labels = c("Full Model", "Stepwise Model"),
  apply.coef = exp,
  digits = 3,
  align = TRUE,
  no.space = TRUE,
  keep.stat = c("n", "aic"),
  notes = "Odds ratios reported. Robust interpretation advised due to stepwise selection.",
  notes.align = "l"
)
```

```{r}
library(stargazer)

# Extract coefficients and compute OR
coef_full <- coef(LR_model)
coef_step <- coef(step_model)

or_full <- exp(coef_full)
or_step <- exp(coef_step)

p_full <- summary(LR_model)$coefficients[,4]
p_step <- summary(step_model)$coefficients[,4]

stargazer(
  LR_model, step_model,
  type = "latex",
  out = "logit_results2.html",
  title = "Logistic Regression Analysis",
  column.labels = c("Full Model", "Stepwise Model"),
  
  coef = list(coef_full, coef_step),
  se = list(or_full, or_step),  # using SE slot to display ORs
  p = list(p_full, p_step),
  align = TRUE,
  digits = 3,
  keep.stat = c("n", "aic"),
  notes = "Log-odds coefficients reported; odds ratios in parentheses; significance based on p-values.",
  notes.align = "l"
)
```
#Multicollinearity assumption

```{r}
LR_model <- glm(psa_binary ~lcavol + lweight + lcp, data = prostate_binary.master, family = binomial(link="logit"))
vif(LR_model)
```

#Walds test
```{r}
#ANOVA or analysis of Deviance
anova(LR_model, test="Chisq")

aod::wald.test(b = coef(LR_model), Sigma = vcov(LR_model), Terms = 2:4)

# LRT or chi-square test
with(LR_model, null.deviance - deviance)
with(LR_model, df.null)
with(LR_model, df.residual)
with(LR_model, df.null - df.residual)
with(LR_model, pchisq(null.deviance - deviance, df.null - df.residual, lower.tail = FALSE))
```


```{r}

LR_model2.train <- glm(psa_binary ~lcavol + lweight + lcp, data = prostate_binary[train_binary, ], family = binomial(link="logit"))

#AIC(LR_model2.train)
#AIC(LR_model)

#summary(LR_model2.train)

#train error 0.8955224
probs <- predict(LR_model2.train, type = "response")
glm.pred <- ifelse(probs > 0.5, 1, 0)

true <- as.numeric(prostate_binary[train_binary,]$psa_binary) - 1
mean(true == glm.pred) # accuracy

table(prostate_binary[train_binary,]$psa_binary, glm.pred) #rows true cols pred


#test error 0.9
probs1 <- predict(LR_model2.train, newdata = prostate_binary[-train_binary, ], type = "response")

glm.pred1 <- ifelse(probs1 > 0.5, 1, 0)
true_test <- as.numeric(prostate_binary$psa_binary[-train_binary]) - 1

table(prostate_binary[-train_binary, ]$psa_binary, glm.pred1) #rows true cols pred
mean(true_test == glm.pred1) # accuracy


pred.lr.factor <- factor(true_test, 
                         levels=c(0,1),
                         labels=c("Low PSA (0)", "High PSA (1)"))
mean(pred.lr.factor == prostate_binary[-train_binary, ]$psa_binary)
confusionMatrix(data=pred.lr.factor, reference=prostate_binary[-train_binary, ]$psa_binary)
#anova(LR_model2.train,LR_model, test = "Chisq")
```

#Fit decision boundary #decision boundary and lcavol is fixed

```{r}
#retrain model using all the data

LR_model2 <- glm(psa_binary ~lcavol + lweight +lcp, data = prostate_binary, family = binomial(link="logit"))

coef(LR_model2)

#Predicted probabilities
prostate_binary$prob <- predict(LR_model2, type = "response")

#Predicted class
prostate_binary$pred_class <- ifelse(
  prostate_binary$prob > 0.5, 1, 0)

#Create lcavol_group in prostate_binary
cuts <- quantile(prostate_binary$lcavol, probs = c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75))

prostate_binary$lcavol_group <- cut(
  prostate_binary$lcavol,
  breaks = c(-Inf, cuts[1], cuts[2], Inf),
  labels = c("Low lcavol", "Medium lcavol", "High lcavol")
)

lcavol_df <- prostate_binary %>%  
  group_by(lcavol_group) %>%
  summarise(
    lcavol = median(lcavol),
    .groups = "drop")


prostate_binary$pred_class <- factor(
  prostate_binary$pred_class,
  levels = c(0, 1),
  labels = c("Low PSA (0)", "High PSA (1)")
)


#Force correct order
prostate_binary$lcavol_group <- factor(
  prostate_binary$lcavol_group,
  levels = c("Low lcavol", "Medium lcavol", "High lcavol")
)

#################
ranges <- prostate_binary %>%
  group_by(lcavol_group) %>%
  summarise(
    lw_min = min(lweight),
    lw_max = max(lweight),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#################

b <- coef(LR_model2)

padding <- 2   # adjust as needed

dbound_trimmed <- ranges %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  do({
    lw_seq <- seq(
      .$lw_min - padding,
      .$lw_max - 1, #+ padding,
      length.out = 200
    )

    lcavol_val <- lcavol_df$lcavol[
      match(.$lcavol_group, lcavol_df$lcavol_group)
    ]

    data.frame(
      lweight = lw_seq,
      lcp = -(b[1] +
               b[2] * lcavol_val +
               b[3] * lw_seq) / b[4],
      lcavol_group = .$lcavol_group
    )
  })

##################
plot_data <- prostate_binary |>
  dplyr::select(lweight, lcp, lcavol_group, psa_binary, pred_class) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(psa_binary, pred_class),
    names_to = "Type",
    values_to = "PSA"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Type = dplyr::recode(
      Type,
      psa_binary = "Observed",
      pred_class = "Predicted"
    )
  )


############
ggplot(plot_data, aes(lweight, lcp)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = PSA), size = 2) +
  geom_line(
    data = dbound_trimmed,
    aes(lweight, lcp),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 1.3,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_grid(Type ~ lcavol_group) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Low PSA (0)" = "dark green",
               "High PSA (1)" = "red"),
    name = "PSA Class"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Observed vs Predicted PSA with Logistic Decision Boundaries",
    subtitle = "Fixed lcavol",
    x = "lweight",
    y = "lcp"
  ) +
  theme_bw()


```

#CV NB

```{r}

response <- "psa_binary"

cv_nb_metrics <- function(data, response, predictors, k = 5, positive = "High PSA (1)", laplace=1) {
  set.seed(123)
  folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = nrow(data)))
  
  metrics <- data.frame(
    accuracy = numeric(k),
    sensitivity = numeric(k),
    specificity = numeric(k),
    precision = numeric(k),
    f1 = numeric(k),
    auc = numeric(k)
  )
  
  for (i in 1:k) {
    train <- data[folds != i, ]
    test  <- data[folds == i, ]
    
    formula <- as.formula(
      paste(response, "~", paste(predictors, collapse = "+"))
    )
    
    model <- naiveBayes(formula, data = train, laplace = laplace)
    
    probs <- predict(model, test, type = "raw")[, positive]
    preds <- predict(model, test)
    
    actual <- test[[response]]
    
    TP <- sum(preds == positive & actual == positive)
    TN <- sum(preds != positive & actual != positive)
    FP <- sum(preds == positive & actual != positive)
    FN <- sum(preds != positive & actual == positive)
    
    metrics$accuracy[i]    <- (TP + TN) / (TP + TN + FP + FN)
    metrics$sensitivity[i] <- ifelse((TP + FN) == 0, NA, TP / (TP + FN))
    metrics$specificity[i] <- ifelse((TN + FP) == 0, NA, TN / (TN + FP))
    metrics$precision[i]   <- ifelse((TP + FP) == 0, NA, TP / (TP + FP))
    metrics$f1[i]          <- ifelse(is.na(metrics$precision[i]) | is.na(metrics$sensitivity[i]),
                                    NA,
                                    2 * metrics$precision[i] * metrics$sensitivity[i] /
                                      (metrics$precision[i] + metrics$sensitivity[i]))
    
    metrics$auc[i] <- as.numeric(roc(actual, probs)$auc)
  }
  
  round(colMeans(metrics, na.rm = TRUE), 4)
}
```

```{r}
response <- "psa_binary"

cv_lda_metrics <- function(data, response, predictors, k = 5, positive = "High PSA (1)") {
  set.seed(123)
  folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = nrow(data)))
  
  metrics <- data.frame(
    accuracy = numeric(k),
    sensitivity = numeric(k),
    specificity = numeric(k),
    precision = numeric(k),
    f1 = numeric(k),
    auc = numeric(k)
  )
  
  for (i in 1:k) {
    train <- data[folds != i, ]
    test  <- data[folds == i, ]
    
    formula <- as.formula(
      paste(response, "~", paste(predictors, collapse = "+"))
    )
    
    model <- lda(formula, data = train)
    
   pred_obj <- predict(model, test)

probs <- pred_obj$posterior[, positive]
preds <- pred_obj$class
    
    actual <- test[[response]]
    
    TP <- sum(preds == positive & actual == positive)
    TN <- sum(preds != positive & actual != positive)
    FP <- sum(preds == positive & actual != positive)
    FN <- sum(preds != positive & actual == positive)
    
    metrics$accuracy[i]    <- (TP + TN) / (TP + TN + FP + FN)
    metrics$sensitivity[i] <- ifelse((TP + FN) == 0, NA, TP / (TP + FN))
    metrics$specificity[i] <- ifelse((TN + FP) == 0, NA, TN / (TN + FP))
    metrics$precision[i]   <- ifelse((TP + FP) == 0, NA, TP / (TP + FP))
    metrics$f1[i]          <- ifelse(is.na(metrics$precision[i]) | is.na(metrics$sensitivity[i]),
                                    NA,
                                    2 * metrics$precision[i] * metrics$sensitivity[i] /
                                      (metrics$precision[i] + metrics$sensitivity[i]))
    
    metrics$auc[i] <- as.numeric(roc(actual, probs)$auc)
  }
  
  round(colMeans(metrics, na.rm = TRUE),4)
}
```

#Measures (70-30)
```{r}
#measures::listAllMeasures()

train_data <- prostate_binary.master[train_binary, ]
test_data <- prostate_binary.master[-train_binary, ]

response <- 'psa_binary'

test_data[[response]]

binary_eval <- function(LR,NB,LDA, test_data, response, negative='Low PSA (0)', positive='High PSA (1)'){

  LR.probs <- predict(LR, newdata=test_data, type="response")

LR.pred <- factor(ifelse(LR.probs > 0.5, positive, negative), levels = c(negative,positive))

NB.probs <- predict(NB, newdata=test_data, type="raw")

NB.pred <- predict(NB, newdata=test_data)

LDA.probs <- predict(LDA, newdata=test_data)

#TPR (Sensitivity)
TPR <- numeric(3)
TPR[1] <- measures::TPR(test_data[[response]],LR.pred,positive)
TPR[2] <- measures::TPR(test_data[[response]],NB.pred,positive)
TPR[3] <- measures::TPR(test_data[[response]],LDA.probs$class,positive)

#TNR (Specificity)
TNR <- numeric(3)
TNR[1] <- measures::TPR(test_data[[response]],LR.pred,negative)
TNR[2] <- measures::TPR(test_data[[response]],NB.pred,negative)
TNR[3] <- measures::TPR(test_data[[response]],LDA.probs$class,negative)

#FPR (Fallout)

colnames(df) <- c("LR", "NB", "LDA")

get_best_model <- function(row_values, desirable) {
  models <- names(row_values)
  values <- as.numeric(row_values)
  
  if (grepl("closer to 1", desirable)) {
    best_val <- max(values)
    idx <- which(values == best_val)
    
  } else if (grepl("closer to 0", desirable) & grepl("-1", desirable)) {
    best_val <- min(abs(values))
    idx <- which(abs(values) == best_val)
    
  } else if (grepl("closer to 0", desirable)) {
    best_val <- min(values)
    idx <- which(values == best_val)
    
  } else {
    stop("Unknown desirable range")
  }
  
  paste(models[idx], collapse = " / ")
}

df$Best_model <- mapply(
  FUN = get_best_model,
  split(df[, c("LR", "NB", "LDA")], seq(nrow(df))),  # each row as list
  df$`Desirable range`                             # corresponding desirable range
)
  
return(df)
}
```

#Cross-validated measures
```{r}
cv_metrics <- function(data, response, predictors.lr, predictors.nb, predictors.lda, k = 5, positive = "High PSA (1)", negative="Low PSA (0)") {
  
  set.seed(123)
  #folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = nrow(data)))
  folds <- createFolds(data[[response]], k = k, list = TRUE)
  
  metrics <- data.frame(
    TPR.LR = numeric(k), TPR.NB = numeric(k), TPR.LDA = numeric(k),
    TNR.LR = numeric(k), TNR.NB = numeric(k), TNR.LDA = numeric(k),
    FPR.LR = numeric(k), FPR.NB = numeric(k), FPR.LDA = numeric(k),
    FNR.LR = numeric(k), FNR.NB = numeric(k), FNR.LDA = numeric(k),
    PPV.LR = numeric(k), PPV.NB = numeric(k), PPV.LDA = numeric(k),
    NPV.LR = numeric(k), NPV.NB = numeric(k), NPV.LDA = numeric(k),
    FDR.LR = numeric(k), FDR.NB = numeric(k), FDR.LDA = numeric(k),
    Youden.LR = numeric(k), Youden.NB = numeric(k), Youden.LDA = numeric(k),
    Dominance.LR = numeric(k), Dominance.NB = numeric(k), Dominance.LDA = numeric(k),
    auc.LR = numeric(k), auc.NB = numeric(k), auc.LDA = numeric(k),
    acc.LR = numeric(k), acc.NB = numeric(k), acc.LDA = numeric(k),
    bac.LR = numeric(k), bac.NB = numeric(k), bac.LDA = numeric(k),
    mcc.LR = numeric(k), mcc.NB = numeric(k), mcc.LDA = numeric(k),
    f1.LR = numeric(k), f1.NB = numeric(k), f1.LDA = numeric(k),
    kappa.LR = numeric(k), kappa.NB = numeric(k), kappa.LDA = numeric(k),
    gmean.LR = numeric(k), gmean.NB = numeric(k), gmean.LDA = numeric(k)
  )
  
  for (i in 1:k) {
    #train <- data[folds != i, ]
    #test  <- data[folds == i, ]
    
    test_idx <- folds[[i]]
  train <- data[-test_idx, ]
  test  <- data[test_idx, ]
    
    formula.lr <- as.formula(
      paste(response, "~", paste(predictors.lr, collapse = "+"))
    )
    
    formula.nb <- as.formula(
      paste(response, "~", paste(predictors.nb, collapse = "+"))
    )
    
    formula.lda <- as.formula(
      paste(response, "~", paste(predictors.lda, collapse = "+"))
    )
    
    model.lr <- glm(formula.lr, data = train, family = binomial(link="logit"))
    model.nb <- naiveBayes(formula.nb, data = train)
    model.lda <- lda(formula.lda, data = train)
    
    #LR
    probs.lr <- predict(model.lr, newdata=test, type="response")
    preds.lr <- factor(ifelse(probs.lr > 0.5, positive, negative), levels = c(negative,positive))
    
    #NB
    probs.nb <- predict(model.nb, test, type = "raw")[, positive]
    preds.nb <- predict(model.nb, test)
    
    #LDA
    probs.lda0 <- predict(model.lda, newdata=test)
    probs.lda <- probs.lda0$posterior[, positive]
    preds.lda <- probs.lda0$class
    
    
    actual <- test[[response]]
    
#TPR (Sensitivity)

metrics$TPR.LR[i] <- measures::TPR(actual,preds.lr,positive)
metrics$TPR.NB[i] <- measures::TPR(actual,preds.nb,positive)
metrics$TPR.LDA[i] <- measures::TPR(actual,preds.lda,positive)


#TNR (Specificity)

metrics$TNR.LR[i] <- measures::TNR(actual,preds.lr,negative)
metrics$TNR.NB[i] <- measures::TNR(actual,preds.nb,negative)
metrics$TNR.LDA[i] <- measures::TNR(actual,preds.lda,negative)


#FPR (Fallout)

metrics$FPR.LR[i] <- measures::FPR(actual,preds.lr,negative,positive)
metrics$FPR.NB[i] <- measures::FPR(actual,preds.nb,negative,positive)
metrics$FPR.LDA[i] <- measures::FPR(actual,preds.lda,negative,positive)


#FNR

metrics$FNR.LR[i] <- measures::FNR(actual,preds.lr,negative,positive)
metrics$FNR.NB[i] <- measures::FNR(actual,preds.nb,negative,positive)
metrics$FNR.LDA[i] <- measures::FNR(actual,preds.lda,negative,positive)


#PPV

metrics$PPV.LR[i] <- measures::PPV(actual,preds.lr,positive,probs.lr)
metrics$PPV.NB[i] <- measures::PPV(actual,preds.nb,positive,probs.nba)
metrics$PPV.LDA[i] <- measures::PPV(actual,preds.lda,positive,probs.lda)


#NPV

metrics$NPV.LR[i] <- measures::NPV(actual,preds.lr,negative)
metrics$NPV.NB[i] <- measures::NPV(actual,preds.nb,negative)
metrics$NPV.LDA[i] <- measures::NPV(actual,preds.lda,negative)

#FDR

metrics$FDR.LR[i] <- measures::FDR(actual,preds.lr,positive)
metrics$FDR.NB[i] <- measures::FDR(actual,preds.nb,positive)
metrics$FDR.LDA[i] <- measures::FDR(actual,preds.lda,positive)

#Youden's J (J=TPR + TNR -1)

metrics$Youden.LR[i] <- metrics$TPR.LR[i] + metrics$TNR.LR[i] - 1
metrics$Youden.NB[i] <- metrics$TPR.NB[i] + metrics$TNR.NB[i] - 1
metrics$Youden.LDA[i] <- metrics$TPR.LDA[i] + metrics$TNR.LDA[i] - 1

#Dominance [+1: perfect accuracy on positive class; 0: desirable]

metrics$Dominance.LR[i] <- metrics$TPR.LR[i] - metrics$TNR.LR[i]
metrics$Dominance.NB[i] <- metrics$TPR.NB[i] - metrics$TNR.NB[i]
metrics$Dominance.LDA[i] <- metrics$TPR.LDA[i] +- metrics$TNR.LDA[i]

#AUC

metrics$auc.LR[i] <- measures::AUC(probs.lr,actual,negative,positive)
metrics$auc.NB[i] <- measures::AUC(probs.nb,actual,negative,positive)
metrics$auc.LDA[i] <- measures::AUC(probs.lda,actual,negative,positive)


#Accuracy (desirable: max)

metrics$acc.LR[i] <- measures::ACC(actual,preds.lr)
metrics$acc.NB[i] <- measures::ACC(actual,preds.nb)
metrics$acc.LDA[i] <- measures::ACC(actual,preds.lda)

#BAC (desirable: max)

metrics$bac.LR[i] <- measures::BAC(actual,preds.lr,negative, positive)
metrics$bac.NB[i] <- measures::BAC(actual,preds.nb,negative, positive)
metrics$bac.LDA[i] <- measures::BAC(actual,preds.lda,negative, positive)

#MCC

metrics$mcc.LR[i] <- measures::MCC(actual,preds.lr,negative, positive)
metrics$mcc.NB[i] <- measures::MCC(actual,preds.nb,negative, positive)
metrics$mcc.LDA[i] <- measures::MCC(actual,preds.lda,negative, positive)

#F1

metrics$f1.LR[i] <- measures::F1(actual,preds.lr,positive) 
metrics$f1.NB[i] <- measures::F1(actual,preds.nb,positive)
metrics$f1.LDA[i] <- measures::F1(actual,preds.lda,positive)

#KAPPA

metrics$kappa.LR[i] <- measures::KAPPA(actual,preds.lr)
metrics$kappa.NB[i] <- measures::KAPPA(actual,preds.nb)
metrics$kappa.LDA[i] <- measures::KAPPA(actual,preds.lda)

#GMEAN

metrics$gmean.LR[i] <- measures::GMEAN(actual,preds.lr,negative,positive)
metrics$gmean.NB[i] <- measures::GMEAN(actual,preds.nb,negative,positive)
metrics$gmean.LDA[i] <- measures::GMEAN(actual,preds.lda,negative,positive)
  }
  
  round(colMeans(metrics, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
}

data <- prostate_binary.master

predictors.lr <- c("lcavol", "lweight", "lcp")
predictors.nb <- c("lcavol", "lweight", "lcp", "age")
predictors.lda <- c("lcavol", "lweight")

response <- 'psa_binary'
z <- cv_metrics(data, response, predictors.lr, predictors.nb, predictors.lda, k = 10, positive = "High PSA (1)", negative="Low PSA (0)")
```

```{r}
  max_depth = c(2, 3, 4),
  eta = c(0.05, 0.1, 0.3),
  gamma = c(0, 1),
  colsample_bytree = c(0.6, 0.8),
  min_child_weight = c(1, 5),
  subsample = c(0.7, 1)
)

set.seed(100)

#xgb_model <- train(
  psa_category ~ .,
  data = prostate_categorical[train_categorical,],
  method = "xgbTree",
  trControl = ctrl.xg,
  tuneGrid = grid.xg
)

xgb_model$bestTune

test_data <- prostate_categorical[-train_categorical,]
pred_test <- predict(xgb_model, test_data)

mean(pred_test == test_data$psa_category)
```


#Random Forest

```{r}
ctrl.rf <- trainControl(
  method = "repeatedcv",
  number = 5
)

grid_rf <- expand.grid(
  mtry = c(2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7)
)

set.seed(123)
rf_model <- train(
  psa_category ~ .,
  data = prostate_categorical[train_categorical,],
  method = "rf",
  trControl = ctrl.rf,
  tuneGrid = grid_rf,
  ntree = 1000
)

rf_model$bestTune #mtry=3
attributes(rf_model)

#CV accuracy (0.6509158) 

max(rf_model$results['Accuracy'])

#train accuracy (100%)
#pred_rf.train <- predict(rf_model, prostate_categorical[train_categorical,])

#mean(pred_rf.train == prostate_categorical$psa_category[train_categorical])

#test accuracy (0.7666667) OVERFITTING
pred_rf <- predict(rf_model, prostate_categorical[-train_categorical,])

mean(pred_rf == prostate_categorical$psa_category[-train_categorical])

varImpPlot(rf_model$finalModel)

imp_df_sorted <- as.data.frame(round(importance(rf_model$finalModel),3)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Variable") %>%
  arrange(desc(MeanDecreaseGini))

gt(imp_df_sorted)

confusionMatrix(data=pred_rf, reference=test_data.cat$psa_category)

```

#bagging

```{r}


ctrl.bag <- trainControl(
  method = "repeatedcv",
  number = 5,
  repeats = 5
)

set.seed(123)
bag_model <- train(
  psa_category ~ .,
  data = prostate_categorical[train_categorical,],
  method = "treebag",
  trControl = ctrl.bag,
  nbagg = 200#,
  #control = rpart.control(
  #  maxdepth = 3,      # limit depth
  #  cp = 0.01,         # pruning
  #  minsplit = 10
  #)
)

bag_model$results

#CV Accuracy 0.638293
max(bag_model$results['Accuracy'])

#test accuracy (0.7333333)
bagging.pred.test <- predict(bag_model, prostate_categorical[-train_categorical,])

mean(bagging.pred.test == prostate_categorical$psa_category[-train_categorical])

attributes(bag_model)

varImp(bag_model)

imp_df <- varImp(bag_model)$importance %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Variable") %>%
  arrange(desc(Overall)) %>%
  mutate(Overall = round(Overall, 3))

gt(imp_df)

confusionMatrix(data=bagging.pred.test, reference=test_data.cat$psa_category)
```
